events.title: Battles of Lexington and Concord
events.titleZh: 列克星敦和康科德战役
events.summary: Armed clashes in Massachusetts turned colonial resistance into open war against British authority.
events.summaryZh: 马萨诸塞的武装冲突把殖民地抵抗转变为公开反抗英国权威的战争。
sourceNotes: Lexington and Concord are standard opening battles of the American Revolutionary War.
events.eventIntro: In April 1775, British troops moved toward Concord to seize colonial military supplies, and local militia confronted them at Lexington and Concord. The fighting was small compared with later wars, but it made negotiation and imperial policing give way to armed revolution.
events.eventIntroZh: 1775 年 4 月，英军前往康科德试图夺取殖民地军事物资，当地民兵在列克星敦和康科德与其交战。战斗规模不大，却让谈判和帝国治安行动转变成武装革命。
events.whyMatters: The event mattered because it linked political protest to organized military resistance. It showed that imperial authority could be challenged by local mobilization, communications networks, militia organization, and claims about rights.
events.whyMattersZh: 它的重要性在于把政治抗议与组织化军事抵抗连接起来。它显示帝国权威可以被地方动员、通信网络、民兵组织和权利主张挑战。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to the Revolutionary and Napoleonic wars phase because modern political legitimacy and mass mobilization began reshaping war before the French Revolution and Napoleon.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“革命战争与拿破仑战争”阶段，因为现代政治合法性和大众动员在法国大革命与拿破仑之前就已经开始重塑战争。
events.connectionHint: This event connects naturally to independence movements, constitutional politics, citizen militias, and later revolutionary wars across the Atlantic world.
events.connectionHintZh: 它自然连接到独立运动、宪政政治、公民民兵，以及后来大西洋世界中的革命战争。
events.imageAlt: Depiction of the Battle of Lexington in 1775
events.imageCaption: A later depiction of Lexington turns a small clash into an emblem of revolutionary armed resistance.
events.imageCaptionZh: 列克星敦战斗的后世图像把一次小规模冲突转化为革命性武装抵抗的象征。

events.title: British surrender at Yorktown
events.summary: The Franco-American victory at Yorktown made British military success in the American war unlikely.
events.summaryZh: 法美联军在约克镇的胜利使英国难以在美国战争中取得军事胜利。
sourceNotes: Yorktown is widely treated as the decisive military turning point of the American Revolutionary War.
events.eventIntro: In 1781, British forces under Cornwallis surrendered at Yorktown after American and French forces trapped them by land and sea. The victory depended on alliance warfare, naval coordination, siege operations, and imperial overstretch.
events.eventIntroZh: 1781 年，康沃利斯率领的英军在约克镇投降，原因是美法联军从陆地和海上将其困住。这场胜利依赖同盟作战、海军协调、围攻行动和帝国过度延伸。
events.whyMatters: Yorktown did not immediately end the war, but it changed diplomatic reality. It made American independence far more likely and showed how a colonial rebellion could become a great-power conflict.
events.whyMattersZh: 约克镇并没有立刻结束战争，但它改变了外交现实。它使美国独立变得更可能，也显示殖民地叛乱如何变成大国冲突。
events.phaseRelation: It fits this phase because revolutionary warfare was not only ideology; it was also logistics, alliances, naval power, and fiscal endurance.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于这个阶段，因为革命战争不只是意识形态，也包括后勤、同盟、海上力量和财政承受力。
events.connectionHint: It connects to French fiscal crisis, Atlantic imperial rivalry, and later debates about republics, armies, and sovereignty.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到法国财政危机、大西洋帝国竞争，以及后来关于共和国、军队和主权的争论。
events.imageAlt: Surrender of Lord Cornwallis at Yorktown
events.imageCaption: The Yorktown surrender image emphasizes alliance warfare and the symbolic defeat of British imperial power.
events.imageCaptionZh: 约克镇投降图像强调同盟战争和英国帝国权力的象征性失败。

events.title: Revolutionary France declares war on Austria
events.titleZh: 革命法国向奥地利宣战
events.summary: France's declaration of war against Austria turned the revolution into a European military crisis.
events.summaryZh: 法国向奥地利宣战使革命变成欧洲军事危机。
sourceNotes: The 1792 declaration opened the French Revolutionary Wars.
events.eventIntro: In 1792, revolutionary France declared war on Austria. A domestic struggle over monarchy, citizenship, and sovereignty became a wider conflict involving courts, armies, borders, and revolutionary ideology.
events.eventIntroZh: 1792 年，革命法国向奥地利宣战。围绕君主制、公民身份和主权的国内斗争，变成涉及宫廷、军队、边界和革命意识形态的更大冲突。
events.whyMatters: The war transformed the revolution itself. Mobilization, suspicion, emergency government, and military success all reshaped French politics and helped make mass politics inseparable from mass war.
events.whyMattersZh: 战争反过来改造了革命本身。动员、猜疑、紧急政府和军事胜利共同重塑法国政治，使大众政治与大众战争难以分离。
events.phaseRelation: It defines this phase because revolutionary war made ideology, citizenship, and armies mutually reinforcing forces.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它定义了这一阶段，因为革命战争让意识形态、公民身份和军队相互强化。
events.connectionHint: It leads toward Valmy, the levée en masse, Napoleon's rise, and the remaking of Europe's state system.
events.connectionHintZh: 它通向瓦尔密、全民征兵、拿破仑崛起，以及欧洲国家体系的重塑。
events.imageAlt: French Revolutionary Army soldiers
events.imageCaption: Revolutionary armies made citizenship, ideology, and military service part of the same political world.
events.imageCaptionZh: 革命军队让公民身份、意识形态和兵役进入同一个政治世界。

events.title: Battle of Valmy
events.summary: French revolutionary forces stopped a Prussian advance and strengthened the new republic's survival.
events.summaryZh: 法国革命军阻止普鲁士推进，并增强新共和国生存的可能性。
sourceNotes: Valmy is often treated as an early symbolic victory for revolutionary France.
events.eventIntro: At Valmy, French revolutionary forces halted a Prussian-led invasion. The battle was not tactically spectacular, but its timing gave the revolution a military proof of survival.
events.eventIntroZh: 在瓦尔密，法国革命军阻止了普鲁士主导的入侵。这场战役在战术上并不华丽，但它出现的时机让革命获得了军事上的生存证明。
events.whyMatters: Valmy helped stabilize the revolution at a moment when foreign invasion and internal crisis threatened it. It showed that citizen-soldier rhetoric could be translated into battlefield endurance.
events.whyMattersZh: 瓦尔密在外敌入侵和内部危机威胁革命时帮助稳定局势。它显示公民士兵的政治语言可以转化为战场承受力。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to this phase because revolutionary legitimacy increasingly depended on the capacity to mobilize and defend the nation.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于这一阶段，因为革命合法性越来越依赖动员和保卫民族的能力。
events.connectionHint: It connects to the French Republic, levée en masse, and later Napoleonic military expansion.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到法兰西共和国、全民征兵和后来的拿破仑军事扩张。
events.imageAlt: Battle of Valmy painting
events.imageCaption: Valmy became a remembered image of revolutionary France surviving armed invasion.
events.imageCaptionZh: 瓦尔密成为革命法国抵御武装入侵并生存下来的记忆图像。

events.title: Battle of Waterloo
events.summary: Napoleon's defeat at Waterloo ended his return to power and helped reset Europe's diplomatic order.
events.summaryZh: 拿破仑在滑铁卢失败，终结其复辟，并帮助重置欧洲外交秩序。
sourceNotes: Waterloo is conventionally treated as the closing battle of the Napoleonic Wars.
events.eventIntro: In 1815, Napoleon's army was defeated near Waterloo by coalition forces under Wellington and Blucher. The battle ended the Hundred Days and closed the long cycle of Revolutionary and Napoleonic wars.
events.eventIntroZh: 1815 年，拿破仑军队在滑铁卢附近被威灵顿和布吕歇尔指挥的联军击败。这场战役终结了百日王朝，也结束了革命与拿破仑战争的漫长周期。
events.whyMatters: Waterloo mattered because it turned military defeat into diplomatic settlement. It strengthened the post-Napoleonic order built around balance, restoration, and managing revolutionary aftershocks.
events.whyMattersZh: 滑铁卢的重要性在于它把军事失败转化为外交安排。它强化了围绕均势、复辟和管控革命余波建立的后拿破仑秩序。
events.phaseRelation: It is the exit point of this phase: revolutionary mobilization and Napoleonic empire had remade Europe, but coalition warfare contained them.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它是这一阶段的出口：革命动员和拿破仑帝国已经重塑欧洲，但联军战争最终遏制了它们。
events.connectionHint: It connects to the Congress of Vienna, nineteenth-century conservatism, and later nationalist challenges to the European order.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到维也纳会议、十九世纪保守主义，以及后来民族主义对欧洲秩序的挑战。
events.imageAlt: Painting of the Battle of Waterloo
events.imageCaption: Waterloo stands as a compressed image of coalition warfare and the end of Napoleonic empire.
events.imageCaptionZh: 滑铁卢浓缩呈现了联军战争和拿破仑帝国终结的形象。

events.title: Crimean War begins
events.summary: War over Ottoman, Russian, British, and French interests exposed the logistics and media of industrial-era conflict.
events.summaryZh: 围绕奥斯曼、俄罗斯、英国和法国利益的战争暴露了工业时代冲突的后勤和媒体特征。
sourceNotes: Crimean War is often used to mark new military logistics, journalism, and medical administration.
events.eventIntro: The Crimean War began from disputes around Ottoman decline, Russian ambition, and European balance-of-power politics. It became a war of sieges, disease, supply failures, press coverage, and military reform debates.
events.eventIntroZh: 克里米亚战争起于奥斯曼衰落、俄罗斯野心和欧洲均势政治的争端。它发展成围攻、疾病、补给失败、新闻报道和军事改革争论交织的战争。
events.whyMatters: Its importance lies in the way modern infrastructure entered war: railways, steamships, telegraphy, battlefield photography, nursing reform, and public criticism of army administration.
events.whyMattersZh: 它的重要性在于现代基础设施进入战争：铁路、蒸汽船、电报、战场摄影、护理改革以及公众对军队行政的批评。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to Industrial wars and imperial crises because it sits between older dynastic war and later industrial mass warfare.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“工业战争与帝国危机”阶段，因为它处在旧式王朝战争和后来的工业化大众战争之间。
events.connectionHint: It connects to Ottoman reform, Russian military weakness, modern war reporting, and medical humanitarian reform.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到奥斯曼改革、俄罗斯军事弱点、现代战争报道和医疗人道改革。
events.imageAlt: Roger Fenton photograph from the Crimean War
events.imageCaption: Crimean War photography made industrial-era war visible to publics far from the battlefield.
events.imageCaptionZh: 克里米亚战争摄影让远离战场的公众也能看到工业时代战争。

events.title: Indian Rebellion of 1857 begins
events.summary: A major uprising against East India Company rule reshaped British imperial governance in South Asia.
events.summaryZh: 反抗东印度公司统治的大规模起义重塑了英国在南亚的帝国治理。
sourceNotes: 1857 is treated as a major military and imperial turning point in South Asian history.
events.eventIntro: In 1857, rebellion spread among soldiers and civilians against East India Company rule. It involved military grievances, religious fears, land and revenue pressures, princely politics, and violence by both rebels and imperial forces.
events.eventIntroZh: 1857 年，反抗东印度公司统治的起义在士兵和平民中扩散。它涉及军事不满、宗教恐惧、土地和税收压力、王公政治，以及起义者和帝国军队双方的暴力。
events.whyMatters: The rebellion mattered because it ended Company rule and brought India under direct British Crown government. It also hardened imperial racial attitudes and reorganized military recruitment.
events.whyMattersZh: 这场起义的重要性在于它终结了公司统治，使印度转入英国王室直接治理。它也强化了帝国种族态度，并重组了军事征募。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to this phase because imperial rule and military organization were inseparable in nineteenth-century global conflict.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于这一阶段，因为十九世纪全球冲突中，帝国统治与军事组织不可分离。
events.connectionHint: It connects to British Raj governance, colonial armies, nationalist memory, and later anti-colonial politics.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到英属印度治理、殖民军队、民族主义记忆和后来的反殖民政治。
events.imageAlt: Scene from the Indian Rebellion of 1857
events.imageCaption: Images of 1857 often reveal how imperial memory framed rebellion, loyalty, punishment, and violence.
events.imageCaptionZh: 1857 年的图像常揭示帝国记忆如何塑造叛乱、忠诚、惩罚与暴力。

events.title: American Civil War begins
events.summary: Secession and the attack on Fort Sumter turned the crisis over slavery and union into civil war.
events.summaryZh: 分离和萨姆特堡遭攻击使围绕奴隶制与联邦的危机变成内战。
sourceNotes: Fort Sumter conventionally marks the start of the American Civil War.
events.eventIntro: In 1861, Confederate forces fired on Fort Sumter after southern secession and the collapse of compromise over slavery and federal power. A constitutional crisis became a large industrial and social war.
events.eventIntroZh: 1861 年，在南方分离和围绕奴隶制与联邦权力的妥协破裂后，邦联军队炮击萨姆特堡。宪政危机变成大规模工业和社会战争。
events.whyMatters: The war mobilized railways, factories, mass armies, finance, medicine, and emancipation politics. It shows how industrial capacity and moral conflict could fuse inside a modern state crisis.
events.whyMattersZh: 这场战争动员了铁路、工厂、大众军队、财政、医疗和解放政治。它显示工业能力与道德冲突如何在现代国家危机中融合。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to this phase because nineteenth-century war increasingly depended on industry, logistics, mass mobilization, and state capacity.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于这一阶段，因为十九世纪战争越来越依赖工业、后勤、大众动员和国家能力。
events.connectionHint: It connects to emancipation, total-war practices, reconstruction, and later debates about citizenship and federal authority.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到奴隶解放、总体战实践、重建，以及后来关于公民身份和联邦权威的争论。
events.imageAlt: Bombardment of Fort Sumter in 1861
events.imageCaption: Fort Sumter became the military threshold between political crisis and civil war.
events.imageCaptionZh: 萨姆特堡成为政治危机转入内战的军事门槛。

events.title: Franco-Prussian War begins
events.summary: War between France and Prussia accelerated German unification and changed Europe's balance of power.
events.summaryZh: 法国与普鲁士的战争加速德意志统一，并改变欧洲均势。
sourceNotes: The war is central to German unification and late nineteenth-century European power politics.
events.eventIntro: In 1870, war broke out between France and Prussia after diplomatic crisis and nationalist pressure. Prussia's military organization, rail mobilization, and coalition of German states overwhelmed the French Empire.
events.eventIntroZh: 1870 年，外交危机和民族主义压力之后，法国与普鲁士开战。普鲁士的军事组织、铁路动员和德意志诸邦联盟压倒了法兰西帝国。
events.whyMatters: The war mattered because it helped create the German Empire and humiliated France, planting grievances that shaped European politics for decades.
events.whyMattersZh: 这场战争的重要性在于它帮助建立德意志帝国并羞辱法国，种下影响欧洲政治数十年的怨恨。
events.phaseRelation: It fits industrial wars because railways, general staffs, conscription, and bureaucratic planning became decisive military instruments.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它符合工业战争阶段，因为铁路、总参谋部、征兵和官僚规划成为决定性军事工具。
events.connectionHint: It connects to German unification, the Paris Commune, alliance politics, and the road toward World War I.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到德意志统一、巴黎公社、同盟政治和通向第一次世界大战的道路。
events.imageAlt: Napoleon III and Bismarck after Sedan
events.imageCaption: Sedan and its aftermath condensed the war's meaning: military defeat, imperial collapse, and German unification.
events.imageCaptionZh: 色当及其后果浓缩了这场战争的意义：军事失败、帝国崩溃与德意志统一。

events.title: Russo-Japanese War begins
events.summary: Japan's war with Russia over Korea and Manchuria signaled a major shift in imperial power in East Asia.
events.summaryZh: 日本与俄罗斯围绕朝鲜和满洲的战争标志东亚帝国力量的重要转变。
sourceNotes: The Russo-Japanese War is a standard turning point in East Asian and global imperial history.
events.eventIntro: In 1904, Japan attacked Russian forces after tensions over Korea and Manchuria. The war combined modern naval power, rail logistics, siege warfare, imperial ambition, and Asian challenges to European prestige.
events.eventIntroZh: 1904 年，日本在围绕朝鲜和满洲的紧张局势后攻击俄罗斯军队。战争结合现代海军力量、铁路后勤、围攻战、帝国野心，以及亚洲国家对欧洲威望的挑战。
events.whyMatters: Japan's victory shocked many observers because a non-Western imperial state defeated a major European empire. It reshaped politics in Russia, Korea, China, Japan, and anti-colonial imaginations elsewhere.
events.whyMattersZh: 日本胜利震动许多观察者，因为一个非西方帝国国家击败了欧洲大帝国。它重塑俄罗斯、朝鲜、中国、日本以及其他地方反殖民想象中的政治。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to this phase because industrial-era war had become global, imperial, naval, and tied to infrastructure across continents.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于这一阶段，因为工业时代战争已经变成全球性、帝国性、海军性，并与跨大陆基础设施绑定。
events.connectionHint: It connects to the Russian Revolution of 1905, Japanese imperial expansion, Korean colonization, and later Pacific conflict.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到 1905 年俄国革命、日本帝国扩张、朝鲜殖民化和后来的太平洋冲突。
events.imageAlt: Depiction of the Battle of Tsushima
events.imageCaption: Tsushima became the emblem of Japan's naval victory and Russia's imperial military crisis.
events.imageCaptionZh: 对马海战成为日本海军胜利和俄罗斯帝国军事危机的象征。

events.title: Assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand
events.titleZh: 弗朗茨·斐迪南大公遇刺
events.summary: The assassination in Sarajevo triggered a diplomatic crisis that escalated into World War I.
events.summaryZh: 萨拉热窝刺杀事件触发外交危机，并升级为第一次世界大战。
sourceNotes: Sarajevo assassination is the conventional trigger event for World War I.
events.eventIntro: In June 1914, Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria-Hungary was assassinated in Sarajevo by Gavrilo Princip. The killing mattered because it entered a tense system of alliances, imperial rivalry, nationalism, and military planning.
events.eventIntroZh: 1914 年 6 月，奥匈帝国的弗朗茨·斐迪南大公在萨拉热窝被加夫里洛·普林西普刺杀。它之所以重要，是因为它进入了同盟、帝国竞争、民族主义和军事计划高度紧张的体系。
events.whyMatters: The assassination alone did not make world war inevitable, but it gave decision-makers a crisis through which fear, prestige, mobilization timetables, and alliance obligations could cascade.
events.whyMattersZh: 刺杀本身并不必然导致世界大战，但它给决策者制造了一个危机，使恐惧、威望、动员时间表和同盟义务连锁升级。
events.phaseRelation: It marks the entry point into World War I and total war because a local nationalist attack became a trigger for system-wide mobilization.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它标志进入第一次世界大战与总体战阶段，因为一次地方民族主义袭击成为系统性动员的触发点。
events.connectionHint: It connects Balkan nationalism, Austro-Hungarian decline, Serbian politics, Russian patronage, and German alliance strategy.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接巴尔干民族主义、奥匈衰落、塞尔维亚政治、俄罗斯庇护和德国同盟战略。
events.imageAlt: Franz Ferdinand in Sarajevo in 1914
events.imageCaption: The Sarajevo visit became one of the most consequential political assassinations in modern history.
events.imageCaptionZh: 萨拉热窝之行成为现代史上后果最重大的政治刺杀之一。

events.title: First Battle of the Marne
events.summary: French and British forces stopped Germany's advance near Paris, helping turn the Western Front into trench war.
events.summaryZh: 法英军队在巴黎附近阻止德军推进，促使西线转入堑壕战。
sourceNotes: First Marne is a standard turning point in the opening campaign of World War I.
events.eventIntro: In September 1914, French and British forces counterattacked German armies near the Marne River. The German advance toward Paris failed, and the war in the west settled into stalemate and trench systems.
events.eventIntroZh: 1914 年 9 月，法英军队在马恩河附近反击德军。德军向巴黎推进失败，西线战争转入僵持和堑壕体系。
events.whyMatters: The battle mattered because it broke expectations of a short war. It made industrial logistics, attrition, reserves, and defensive firepower central to the conflict.
events.whyMattersZh: 这场战役重要，因为它打破了短期战争的预期。它让工业后勤、消耗、预备队和防御火力成为冲突核心。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to World War I and total war because it helped turn mobile invasion into prolonged industrial attrition.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于第一次世界大战与总体战阶段，因为它帮助把机动作战转变为长期工业消耗战。
events.connectionHint: It connects to trench warfare, the Western Front, French national defense, and the later battles of Verdun and the Somme.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到堑壕战、西线、法国国土防御，以及后来的凡尔登和索姆河战役。
events.imageAlt: Marne taxi associated with the First Battle of the Marne
events.imageCaption: The Marne taxi became a popular symbol of emergency mobilization in defense of Paris.
events.imageCaptionZh: “马恩河出租车”成为保卫巴黎紧急动员的流行象征。

events.title: Gallipoli campaign begins
events.summary: Allied forces attacked the Ottoman-held Dardanelles, opening a costly campaign with lasting national memories.
events.summaryZh: 协约国攻击奥斯曼控制的达达尼尔海峡，开启代价高昂且留下深远民族记忆的战役。
sourceNotes: Gallipoli is central to Ottoman, Turkish, Australian, and New Zealand war memory.
events.eventIntro: In 1915, Allied forces tried to force the Dardanelles and knock the Ottoman Empire out of the war. The campaign became a failed amphibious operation marked by terrain, disease, command mistakes, and stubborn defense.
events.eventIntroZh: 1915 年，协约国试图突破达达尼尔海峡并迫使奥斯曼帝国退出战争。这场战役成为失败的两栖行动，受地形、疾病、指挥错误和顽强防御影响。
events.whyMatters: Gallipoli mattered because it showed the global and imperial geography of World War I beyond the Western Front. It also became foundational to Turkish, Australian, and New Zealand national memory.
events.whyMattersZh: 加里波利的重要性在于它显示第一次世界大战不只是西线，而具有全球和帝国地理。它也成为土耳其、澳大利亚和新西兰民族记忆的基础。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to total war because empires mobilized soldiers from across the world for strategic chokepoints and imperial survival.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于总体战阶段，因为帝国为了战略要道和自身存续，从全球各地动员士兵。
events.connectionHint: It connects to Ottoman collapse, ANZAC memory, amphibious warfare, and postwar national identity.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到奥斯曼崩溃、澳新军团记忆、两栖作战和战后民族身份。
events.imageAlt: Allied landing at Gallipoli in 1915
events.imageCaption: Gallipoli images show the campaign's amphibious difficulty and exposed terrain.
events.imageCaptionZh: 加里波利图像显示这场两栖战役的困难和暴露地形。

events.title: Battle of Verdun begins
events.summary: Verdun became a symbol of attrition, endurance, artillery, and national sacrifice on the Western Front.
events.summaryZh: 凡尔登成为西线消耗、承受、炮火和民族牺牲的象征。
sourceNotes: Verdun is one of the defining battles of World War I attrition.
events.eventIntro: The Battle of Verdun began in 1916 as Germany attacked a symbolically important French fortress region. The fighting lasted months and became one of the war's most brutal examples of artillery-driven attrition.
events.eventIntroZh: 凡尔登战役始于 1916 年，德国攻击对法国具有象征意义的要塞地区。战斗持续数月，成为这场战争中炮火驱动消耗战最残酷的例子之一。
events.whyMatters: Verdun mattered because it turned endurance itself into strategy and memory. It made the human cost of industrial firepower central to French and European remembrance.
events.whyMattersZh: 凡尔登重要，因为它把承受本身变成战略和记忆。它让工业火力的人类代价成为法国和欧洲记忆的核心。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to World War I total war because national morale, artillery production, logistics, and mass casualties became inseparable.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于第一次世界大战总体战阶段，因为民族士气、炮弹生产、后勤和大规模伤亡不可分离。
events.connectionHint: It connects to artillery industry, trench warfare, memorial culture, and the politics of sacrifice after 1918.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到炮兵工业、堑壕战、纪念文化和 1918 年后的牺牲政治。
events.imageAlt: Verdun battlefield landscape
events.imageCaption: Verdun's landscape became a scarred monument to artillery and attrition.
events.imageCaptionZh: 凡尔登地貌成为炮火和消耗战留下伤痕的纪念物。

events.title: Armistice ends fighting in World War I
events.titleZh: 停战协定结束第一次世界大战战斗
events.summary: The armistice stopped fighting on the Western Front while leaving peace terms and political collapse unresolved.
events.summaryZh: 停战协定停止西线战斗，但和平条件和政治崩溃仍未解决。
sourceNotes: The 11 November 1918 armistice ended major fighting in World War I.
events.eventIntro: On 11 November 1918, Germany signed an armistice with the Allies, ending fighting on the Western Front. The guns stopped before the political, territorial, social, and economic consequences of the war were settled.
events.eventIntroZh: 1918 年 11 月 11 日，德国与协约国签署停战协定，结束西线战斗。炮声停止时，战争的政治、领土、社会和经济后果尚未解决。
events.whyMatters: The armistice mattered because it marked military exhaustion without stable peace. Empires collapsed, revolutions spread, borders were redrawn, and grief entered public life.
events.whyMattersZh: 停战重要，因为它标志军事耗竭，却不等于稳定和平。帝国崩溃、革命扩散、边界重划，悲痛进入公共生活。
events.phaseRelation: It is the exit point of the World War I phase: total war ended in military terms but continued through treaties, memory, debt, and political radicalization.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它是第一次世界大战阶段的出口：总体战在军事上结束，却通过条约、记忆、债务和政治激进化继续存在。
events.connectionHint: It connects directly to Versailles, the League of Nations, interwar revisionism, and later militarization.
events.connectionHintZh: 它直接连接到凡尔赛体系、国际联盟、战间期修正主义和后来的军事化。
events.imageAlt: Crowd celebrating Armistice Day in 1918
events.imageCaption: Armistice celebrations captured relief, grief, and uncertainty at the end of World War I fighting.
events.imageCaptionZh: 停战庆祝图像捕捉了第一次世界大战战斗结束时的解脱、悲痛和不确定。

events.title: March on Rome
events.summary: Mussolini's Fascists used paramilitary pressure and political crisis to enter power in Italy.
events.summaryZh: 墨索里尼的法西斯运动利用准军事压力和政治危机进入意大利权力中心。
sourceNotes: March on Rome is commonly treated as the key Fascist seizure of power moment.
events.eventIntro: In 1922, Fascist squads and political pressure converged in the March on Rome, after which Mussolini was invited to form a government. The event blurred legal appointment, street violence, elite fear, and paramilitary spectacle.
events.eventIntroZh: 1922 年，法西斯小队和政治压力在“向罗马进军”中汇合，随后墨索里尼被邀请组阁。这个事件模糊了合法任命、街头暴力、精英恐惧和准军事表演的边界。
events.whyMatters: It mattered because interwar militarization did not always begin as battlefield war. Uniformed movements, veterans, political violence, and anti-socialist panic could transform state power from within.
events.whyMattersZh: 它重要，因为战间期军事化并不总是从战场战争开始。制服运动、退伍军人、政治暴力和反社会主义恐慌可以从内部改造国家权力。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to interwar militarization because paramilitary politics became a bridge between World War I trauma and authoritarian mass politics.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于战间期军事化阶段，因为准军事政治成为第一次世界大战创伤与威权大众政治之间的桥梁。
events.connectionHint: It connects to fascism, veterans' politics, political violence, and later Axis militarization.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到法西斯主义、退伍军人政治、政治暴力和后来的轴心国军事化。
events.imageAlt: Fascist March on Rome in 1922
events.imageCaption: The March on Rome used political theater and paramilitary pressure to make power transfer appear inevitable.
events.imageCaptionZh: 向罗马进军利用政治剧场和准军事压力，使权力转移显得不可避免。

events.title: Japan invades Manchuria
events.summary: Japan's seizure of Manchuria challenged international order and expanded militarized imperial rule in East Asia.
events.summaryZh: 日本夺取满洲挑战国际秩序，并扩大东亚军事化帝国统治。
sourceNotes: The 1931 Manchurian Incident is a major step in Japanese imperial expansion.
events.eventIntro: In 1931, Japan's Kwantung Army used the Mukden Incident as a pretext to occupy Manchuria and later establish Manchukuo. The action revealed how military actors could drive imperial policy beyond civilian control.
events.eventIntroZh: 1931 年，日本关东军利用九一八事变作为借口占领满洲，后来建立满洲国。此举显示军事力量可以推动帝国政策并超出文官控制。
events.whyMatters: The invasion mattered because it exposed the weakness of collective security and escalated Japanese militarism. It also brought Chinese sovereignty, resource extraction, settlement, and puppet-state politics into one conflict zone.
events.whyMattersZh: 这次侵占重要，因为它暴露集体安全的软弱，并加速日本军事主义。它也把中国主权、资源开采、移民和傀儡国家政治带入同一冲突区域。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to interwar militarization because it shows imperial expansion before formal World War II, with military initiative shaping state strategy.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于战间期军事化，因为它展示了正式第二次世界大战前的帝国扩张，以及军事主动如何塑造国家战略。
events.connectionHint: It connects to the League of Nations crisis, Sino-Japanese War, resource imperialism, and Pacific War origins.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到国际联盟危机、中日战争、资源帝国主义和太平洋战争起源。
events.imageAlt: Japanese troops entering Mukden in 1931
events.imageCaption: The Manchurian occupation showed how local military action could reorder a region.
events.imageCaptionZh: 满洲占领显示地方军事行动如何重组一个地区。

events.title: Hitler appointed German chancellor
events.titleZh: 希特勒被任命为德国总理
events.summary: Hitler's appointment opened the path from electoral crisis to dictatorship, rearmament, and war.
events.summaryZh: 希特勒被任命为总理，开启从选举危机到独裁、重新武装和战争的道路。
sourceNotes: Hitler's appointment is a central political event in interwar militarization and Nazi dictatorship.
events.eventIntro: In January 1933, Adolf Hitler was appointed chancellor of Germany. Conservative elites believed they could control him, but the appointment opened a rapid path to dictatorship, rearmament, racial state policy, and aggressive expansion.
events.eventIntroZh: 1933 年 1 月，阿道夫·希特勒被任命为德国总理。保守精英以为可以控制他，但这一任命迅速打开通向独裁、重新武装、种族国家政策和侵略扩张的道路。
events.whyMatters: This event mattered because militarization became state policy before war began. Rearmament, propaganda, paramilitary violence, and territorial revisionism were built into the Nazi project.
events.whyMattersZh: 这个事件重要，因为战争开始前军事化已经成为国家政策。重新武装、宣传、准军事暴力和领土修正主义被纳入纳粹工程。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to interwar militarization because authoritarian politics and military expansion formed together.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于战间期军事化阶段，因为威权政治和军事扩张共同形成。
events.connectionHint: It connects to the collapse of Weimar democracy, anti-communism, Versailles revisionism, and World War II.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到魏玛民主崩溃、反共、凡尔赛修正主义和第二次世界大战。
events.imageAlt: Adolf Hitler portrait from the 1930s
events.imageCaption: Hitler's appointment turned extremist movement politics into state power.
events.imageCaptionZh: 希特勒的任命把极端运动政治转化为国家权力。

events.title: Spanish Civil War begins
events.summary: A military uprising against the Spanish Republic became an internationalized ideological civil war.
events.summaryZh: 反对西班牙共和国的军事起义变成国际化的意识形态内战。
sourceNotes: Spanish Civil War is a core interwar conflict involving fascist, communist, anarchist, liberal, and conservative forces.
events.eventIntro: In 1936, a military uprising against Spain's elected Popular Front government became a civil war. Foreign intervention, ideological polarization, aerial bombing, militia politics, and civilian terror made it a rehearsal for wider war.
events.eventIntroZh: 1936 年，反对西班牙人民阵线政府的军事起义变成内战。外国干预、意识形态极化、空中轰炸、民兵政治和平民恐怖使它成为更大规模战争的预演。
events.whyMatters: The war mattered because Spain became a battlefield for fascism, anti-fascism, communism, anarchism, and liberal democracy. It also made modern bombing and propaganda visible to global publics.
events.whyMattersZh: 这场战争重要，因为西班牙成为法西斯主义、反法西斯主义、共产主义、无政府主义和自由民主的战场。它也让现代轰炸和宣传进入全球公众视野。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to interwar militarization because civil war, ideology, and foreign military experimentation converged before World War II.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于战间期军事化阶段，因为内战、意识形态和外国军事试验在第二次世界大战前汇合。
events.connectionHint: It connects to Guernica, international brigades, fascist alliances, Soviet support, and postwar dictatorship.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到格尔尼卡、国际纵队、法西斯同盟、苏联援助和战后独裁。
events.imageAlt: Ruins associated with Guernica during the Spanish Civil War
events.imageCaption: Guernica became a symbol of aerial bombing, civilian vulnerability, and international outrage.
events.imageCaptionZh: 格尔尼卡成为空中轰炸、平民脆弱性和国际愤怒的象征。

events.title: Munich Agreement
events.summary: Britain and France accepted German annexation of the Sudetenland, exposing the failure of appeasement.
events.summaryZh: 英国和法国接受德国吞并苏台德地区，暴露绥靖政策失败。
sourceNotes: Munich is a standard symbol of appeasement and interwar diplomatic failure.
events.eventIntro: In 1938, Britain and France accepted Germany's demand for the Sudetenland in Czechoslovakia without Czechoslovak participation in the final decision. The agreement was presented as peace but rewarded coercive revisionism.
events.eventIntroZh: 1938 年，英国和法国接受德国对捷克斯洛伐克苏台德地区的要求，而捷克斯洛伐克没有参与最终决定。协定被包装为和平，却奖励了胁迫性修正主义。
events.whyMatters: Munich mattered because it showed how fear of another world war could undermine collective resistance to aggression. It also convinced Hitler that risk-taking could succeed.
events.whyMattersZh: 慕尼黑重要，因为它显示对另一场世界大战的恐惧如何削弱对侵略的集体抵抗。它也让希特勒相信冒险可以成功。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to interwar militarization because diplomacy, territorial revision, and the threat of force were already operating as war by other means.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于战间期军事化，因为外交、领土修正和武力威胁已经像另一种战争形式一样运行。
events.connectionHint: It connects to appeasement, the collapse of Czechoslovakia, German expansion, and the invasion of Poland.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到绥靖、捷克斯洛伐克瓦解、德国扩张和入侵波兰。
events.imageAlt: Leaders at the Munich Agreement in 1938
events.imageCaption: Munich shows diplomacy under threat, where signatures could not secure a durable peace.
events.imageCaptionZh: 慕尼黑展示了威胁下的外交：签名并不能确保持久和平。

events.title: Germany invades Poland
events.summary: Germany's invasion of Poland triggered Britain and France to declare war, beginning World War II in Europe.
events.summaryZh: 德国入侵波兰促使英国和法国宣战，欧洲第二次世界大战开始。
sourceNotes: The invasion of Poland is the conventional start of World War II in Europe.
events.eventIntro: On 1 September 1939, Germany invaded Poland using aircraft, armor, infantry, and propaganda around a manufactured border crisis. Britain and France declared war days later, while the Soviet Union invaded eastern Poland under the Nazi-Soviet pact.
events.eventIntroZh: 1939 年 9 月 1 日，德国以制造出的边境危机为借口，使用飞机、装甲、步兵和宣传入侵波兰。数日后英法宣战，苏联也根据德苏协定入侵波兰东部。
events.whyMatters: The invasion mattered because it turned revisionist aggression into a European war. It also revealed the violence of occupation, partition, and racial-imperial planning from the beginning.
events.whyMattersZh: 这次入侵重要，因为它把修正主义侵略转化为欧洲战争。它也从一开始就揭示占领、瓜分和种族帝国规划的暴力。
events.phaseRelation: It opens the World War II phase because mechanized assault, alliance commitments, and ideological empire converged in one campaign.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它开启第二次世界大战阶段，因为机械化进攻、同盟承诺和意识形态帝国在同一战役中汇合。
events.connectionHint: It connects to the Nazi-Soviet pact, occupation policy, Holocaust preconditions, and the wider European war.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到德苏协定、占领政策、 Holocaust 的前提，以及更广泛的欧洲战争。
events.imageAlt: German invasion of Poland and fighting around Warsaw
events.imageCaption: The invasion of Poland made mechanized aggression and occupation central to World War II from its first days.
events.imageCaptionZh: 入侵波兰从战争最初几天起就让机械化侵略和占领成为第二次世界大战核心。

events.title: Fall of France
events.summary: Germany defeated France and forced Britain from continental Europe, transforming the war's balance.
events.summaryZh: 德国击败法国并迫使英国撤离欧洲大陆，改变战争均势。
sourceNotes: Fall of France is a central 1940 turning point in World War II.
events.eventIntro: In 1940, German forces attacked through the Low Countries and the Ardennes, splitting Allied armies and forcing a rapid collapse of French resistance. The campaign ended with occupation, Vichy rule, and Britain fighting on.
events.eventIntroZh: 1940 年，德军经低地国家和阿登发动进攻，分割盟军并迫使法国抵抗迅速崩溃。战役结果是占领、维希政权和英国继续作战。
events.whyMatters: The fall of France mattered because it shattered assumptions about static defense and great-power stability. It made occupation, collaboration, resistance, exile, and air defense central to the war.
events.whyMattersZh: 法国沦陷重要，因为它粉碎了关于静态防御和大国稳定的假设。它让占领、合作、抵抗、流亡和空防成为战争核心。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to mechanized global war because armored movement, air support, command tempo, and operational surprise reshaped battlefield expectations.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于机械化全球战争阶段，因为装甲机动、空中支援、指挥节奏和战役突然性重塑了战场预期。
events.connectionHint: It connects to Dunkirk, Vichy France, Free France, the Battle of Britain, and later liberation campaigns.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到敦刻尔克、维希法国、自由法国、不列颠空战和后来的解放战役。
events.imageAlt: German tanks in France in 1940
events.imageCaption: The 1940 campaign made armored mobility and operational shock central images of World War II.
events.imageCaptionZh: 1940 年战役让装甲机动和战役冲击成为第二次世界大战的核心图像。

events.title: Operation Barbarossa begins
events.summary: Germany's invasion of the Soviet Union opened the largest land front of World War II.
events.summaryZh: 德国入侵苏联，开启第二次世界大战最大的陆上战线。
sourceNotes: Barbarossa is a central turning point in World War II and Holocaust history.
events.eventIntro: In June 1941, Germany launched Operation Barbarossa against the Soviet Union. The invasion joined military ambition to ideological war, racial policy, occupation, starvation planning, and mass violence.
events.eventIntroZh: 1941 年 6 月，德国对苏联发动巴巴罗萨行动。这次入侵把军事野心与意识形态战争、种族政策、占领、饥饿计划和大规模暴力结合起来。
events.whyMatters: Barbarossa mattered because it made the Eastern Front the decisive theater of European war. It also radicalized the scale of killing against soldiers, civilians, Jews, and occupied populations.
events.whyMattersZh: 巴巴罗萨重要，因为它让东线成为欧洲战争的决定性战场。它也极大扩大了针对士兵、平民、犹太人和被占领人群的杀戮规模。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to World War II mechanized global war because motorized advance, logistics failure, ideology, and annihilation policy collided.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于第二次世界大战机械化全球战争阶段，因为机动推进、后勤失败、意识形态和灭绝政策发生碰撞。
events.connectionHint: It connects to the Holocaust, Soviet mobilization, Stalingrad, partisan warfare, and postwar Eastern Europe.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到 Holocaust、苏联动员、斯大林格勒、游击战和战后东欧。
events.imageAlt: German infantry advancing during Operation Barbarossa
events.imageCaption: Barbarossa images reveal a war of movement that soon became a war of occupation and annihilation.
events.imageCaptionZh: 巴巴罗萨图像显示，一场机动作战很快变成占领与毁灭战争。

events.title: Attack on Pearl Harbor
events.summary: Japan's attack on Pearl Harbor brought the United States directly into World War II.
events.summaryZh: 日本袭击珍珠港，使美国直接加入第二次世界大战。
sourceNotes: Pearl Harbor is the standard event marking U.S. entry into World War II.
events.eventIntro: On 7 December 1941, Japanese aircraft attacked the U.S. Pacific Fleet at Pearl Harbor. The strike was meant to disable American naval power long enough for Japan to consolidate expansion in Asia and the Pacific.
events.eventIntroZh: 1941 年 12 月 7 日，日本飞机袭击珍珠港的美国太平洋舰队。日本意图暂时瘫痪美国海军力量，以便巩固其在亚洲和太平洋的扩张。
events.whyMatters: The attack mattered because it turned the United States from a major supporter of the Allies into a direct belligerent. It linked the European and Pacific wars into a single global conflict.
events.whyMattersZh: 这次袭击重要，因为它使美国从盟国的重要支持者变成直接参战国。它把欧洲战争和太平洋战争连接成一场全球冲突。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to World War II because naval aviation, surprise attack, imperial strategy, and industrial mobilization converged.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于第二次世界大战阶段，因为海军航空、突然袭击、帝国战略和工业动员在这里汇合。
events.connectionHint: It connects to Pacific island warfare, U.S. industrial mobilization, Japanese empire, and the atomic end of the war.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到太平洋岛屿战争、美国工业动员、日本帝国和战争的原子结局。
events.imageAlt: Pearl Harbor and Battleship Row before the attack
events.imageCaption: Pearl Harbor became the visual shorthand for surprise attack and U.S. entry into global war.
events.imageCaptionZh: 珍珠港成为突然袭击和美国进入全球战争的视觉 shorthand。

events.title: D-Day landings in Normandy
events.summary: Allied forces landed in Normandy, opening a western front against Nazi Germany.
events.summaryZh: 盟军在诺曼底登陆，开辟对纳粹德国的西线。
sourceNotes: D-Day is the core opening event of the Normandy campaign.
events.eventIntro: On 6 June 1944, Allied forces landed on Normandy beaches in the largest amphibious invasion of the war. The operation required deception, air power, naval fire, logistics, engineering, and multinational coordination.
events.eventIntroZh: 1944 年 6 月 6 日，盟军在诺曼底海滩登陆，这是战争中最大规模的两栖入侵。行动需要欺骗、空中力量、海军火力、后勤、工程和多国协调。
events.whyMatters: D-Day mattered because it opened a sustained western front and made liberation of occupied Western Europe possible. It also demonstrated the enormous organizational scale of Allied warfare.
events.whyMattersZh: 诺曼底登陆重要，因为它打开了持续的西线，使解放被占领的西欧成为可能。它也展示盟军战争组织的巨大规模。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to World War II mechanized global war because industrial logistics and combined arms made amphibious invasion possible at unprecedented scale.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于第二次世界大战机械化全球战争阶段，因为工业后勤和联合作战使前所未有规模的两栖入侵成为可能。
events.connectionHint: It connects to resistance networks, air superiority, liberation, German collapse, and postwar memory.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到抵抗网络、制空权、解放、德国崩溃和战后记忆。
events.imageAlt: U.S. troops landing at Omaha Beach on D-Day
events.imageCaption: The Omaha Beach photograph became one of the most recognizable images of amphibious warfare.
events.imageCaptionZh: 奥马哈海滩照片成为两栖作战最具辨识度的图像之一。
events.imageCredit: Image: U.S. Coast Guard / Wikimedia Commons

events.title: Atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki
events.titleZh: 广岛与长崎原子弹轰炸
events.summary: The United States used atomic bombs against Japanese cities, helping end the war and beginning the nuclear age.
events.summaryZh: 美国对日本城市使用原子弹，促成战争结束并开启核时代。
sourceNotes: The atomic bombings are central events in World War II and nuclear history.
events.eventIntro: In August 1945, the United States dropped atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki. The bombings killed civilians on a massive scale, shocked Japan's leadership, and revealed a new category of destructive power.
events.eventIntroZh: 1945 年 8 月，美国向广岛和长崎投下原子弹。轰炸造成大规模平民死亡，震动日本领导层，并展示一种新的毁灭力量。
events.whyMatters: The bombings mattered because they connected the end of World War II to the beginning of nuclear politics. Military victory, civilian suffering, scientific state power, and moral controversy became inseparable.
events.whyMattersZh: 它们的重要性在于把第二次世界大战结束与核政治开始连接起来。军事胜利、平民苦难、科学国家权力和道德争议从此难以分离。
events.phaseRelation: They close the World War II phase while pointing toward Cold War nuclear systems and deterrence.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它们结束第二次世界大战阶段，同时指向冷战核体系和威慑。
events.connectionHint: This event connects to the Manhattan Project, Japanese surrender, nuclear deterrence, arms control, and hibakusha memory.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到曼哈顿计划、日本投降、核威慑、军控和被爆者记忆。
events.imageAlt: Mushroom cloud from atomic bombing of Japan
events.imageCaption: Atomic bombing images made nuclear destruction a permanent part of modern war memory.
events.imageCaptionZh: 原子弹轰炸图像让核毁灭永久进入现代战争记忆。

events.title: Berlin Blockade begins
events.summary: The Soviet blockade of West Berlin triggered an Allied airlift and hardened Cold War division.
events.summaryZh: 苏联封锁西柏林，引发盟军空运并强化冷战分裂。
sourceNotes: Berlin Blockade is a defining early Cold War crisis.
events.eventIntro: In 1948, the Soviet Union blocked land routes to West Berlin, and Western Allies responded with a massive airlift. The crisis turned occupation zones into a symbolic front line of Cold War rivalry.
events.eventIntroZh: 1948 年，苏联封锁通往西柏林的陆路，西方盟国以大规模空运回应。危机把占领区变成冷战竞争的象征性前线。
events.whyMatters: The blockade mattered because it showed how Cold War conflict could operate below direct war between superpowers. Logistics, morale, air transport, and alliance credibility became strategic weapons.
events.whyMattersZh: 柏林封锁重要，因为它显示冷战冲突可以在超级大国直接战争以下运作。后勤、士气、空运和同盟可信度都成为战略武器。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to Cold War conflict because deterrence and confrontation were organized through crisis management rather than open battle.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于冷战冲突阶段，因为威慑和对抗通过危机管理而非公开战斗组织起来。
events.connectionHint: It connects to NATO, divided Germany, air logistics, and the Berlin Wall.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到北约、分裂德国、空中后勤和柏林墙。
events.imageAlt: Airlift aircraft landing at Berlin Tempelhof during the blockade
events.imageCaption: The airlift made logistics and civilian survival central Cold War images.
events.imageCaptionZh: 柏林空运让后勤和平民生存成为冷战核心图像。

events.title: Korean War begins
events.summary: North Korea's invasion of South Korea internationalized the Cold War in East Asia.
events.summaryZh: 朝鲜入侵韩国，使冷战在东亚国际化。
sourceNotes: Korean War is a core Cold War proxy and UN military conflict.
events.eventIntro: In 1950, North Korean forces crossed the 38th parallel and invaded South Korea. The United States, United Nations forces, China, and Soviet support soon made the conflict part of the global Cold War.
events.eventIntroZh: 1950 年，朝鲜军队越过三八线入侵韩国。美国、联合国军、中国和苏联支持很快使这场冲突成为全球冷战的一部分。
events.whyMatters: The war mattered because it militarized containment, devastated Korea, and showed that Cold War competition could become hot war through divided states.
events.whyMattersZh: 这场战争重要，因为它军事化了遏制政策，重创朝鲜半岛，并显示冷战竞争可以通过分裂国家变成热战。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to Cold War proxy conflict because superpower rivalry was fought through local division, alliances, and limited-war rules.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于冷战代理战争阶段，因为超级大国竞争通过地方分裂、同盟和有限战争规则展开。
events.connectionHint: It connects to divided Korea, U.S. alliances in Asia, Chinese revolutionary state power, and later proxy wars.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到朝鲜半岛分裂、美国亚洲同盟、中国革命国家权力和后来的代理战争。
events.imageAlt: Korean War montage
events.imageCaption: Korean War imagery shows Cold War conflict becoming devastating conventional war.
events.imageCaptionZh: 朝鲜战争图像显示冷战冲突如何变成毁灭性的常规战争。

events.title: Cuban Missile Crisis
events.summary: The United States and Soviet Union came close to nuclear war over Soviet missiles in Cuba.
events.summaryZh: 美国和苏联因苏联在古巴部署导弹而接近核战争。
sourceNotes: Cuban Missile Crisis is a central nuclear brinkmanship episode.
events.eventIntro: In 1962, U.S. reconnaissance revealed Soviet nuclear missiles in Cuba. The crisis produced naval quarantine, secret negotiations, military alerts, and a direct confrontation over nuclear risk.
events.eventIntroZh: 1962 年，美国侦察发现苏联在古巴部署核导弹。危机引发海上封锁、秘密谈判、军事戒备和围绕核风险的直接对抗。
events.whyMatters: It mattered because nuclear deterrence became a lived political crisis rather than an abstract strategy. The world saw how miscalculation, signaling, and command systems could decide survival.
events.whyMattersZh: 它重要，因为核威慑从抽象战略变成现实政治危机。世界看到误判、信号传递和指挥系统如何决定生存。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to Cold War nuclear deterrence because military power centered on avoiding war as much as preparing for it.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于冷战核威慑阶段，因为军事力量既围绕备战，也围绕避免战争。
events.connectionHint: It connects to arms control, hotline diplomacy, missile technology, and later nuclear crisis management.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到军控、热线外交、导弹技术和后来的核危机管理。
events.imageAlt: U-2 reconnaissance photograph from the Cuban Missile Crisis
events.imageCaption: Reconnaissance imagery made hidden nuclear deployment visible to decision-makers.
events.imageCaptionZh: 侦察图像让隐藏的核部署进入决策者视野。

events.title: Tet Offensive
events.summary: North Vietnamese and Viet Cong attacks reshaped U.S. public perception of the Vietnam War.
events.summaryZh: 北越和越共的攻势重塑美国公众对越南战争的看法。
sourceNotes: Tet Offensive is central to Vietnam War and media-war histories.
events.eventIntro: In 1968, North Vietnamese and Viet Cong forces launched coordinated attacks during Tet. Although militarily costly for them, the offensive challenged official U.S. claims that victory was near.
events.eventIntroZh: 1968 年，北越和越共在春节期间发动协调攻势。尽管他们付出高昂军事代价，这次攻势挑战了美国官方关于胜利在望的说法。
events.whyMatters: Tet mattered because the politics of perception became part of war. Television, credibility, casualty counts, and public trust shaped strategy alongside battlefield results.
events.whyMattersZh: 春节攻势重要，因为感知政治成为战争的一部分。电视、可信度、伤亡数字和公众信任与战场结果一起塑造战略。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to Cold War proxy war because local revolutionary war, superpower commitment, and mass media interacted.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于冷战代理战争阶段，因为地方革命战争、超级大国承诺和大众媒介发生互动。
events.connectionHint: It connects to antiwar movements, televised war, counterinsurgency, and U.S. political crisis in 1968.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到反战运动、电视战争、反叛乱和 1968 年美国政治危机。
events.imageAlt: Tet Offensive combat in 1968
events.imageCaption: Tet Offensive imagery linked urban combat to the politics of television war.
events.imageCaptionZh: 春节攻势图像把城市战斗与电视战争政治连接起来。

events.title: Soviet-Afghan War begins
events.summary: The Soviet intervention in Afghanistan became a long proxy conflict with regional and global consequences.
events.summaryZh: 苏联干预阿富汗变成长时间代理冲突，并产生地区与全球后果。
sourceNotes: Soviet-Afghan War is a major late Cold War proxy conflict.
events.eventIntro: In 1979, Soviet forces entered Afghanistan to support a friendly government facing insurgency and internal crisis. The intervention became a long war involving guerrillas, refugees, foreign aid, Islamic mobilization, and superpower rivalry.
events.eventIntroZh: 1979 年，苏联军队进入阿富汗，支持面对叛乱和内部危机的亲苏政府。干预变成长战争，涉及游击队、难民、外国援助、伊斯兰动员和超级大国竞争。
events.whyMatters: The war mattered because it drained Soviet resources and helped internationalize militant networks. It showed the limits of conventional power against insurgency in difficult terrain.
events.whyMattersZh: 这场战争重要，因为它消耗苏联资源，并帮助国际化武装网络。它显示常规力量在复杂地形中面对叛乱的限制。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to Cold War proxy war because local conflict became a theater for ideological, military, and intelligence competition.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于冷战代理战争，因为地方冲突成为意识形态、军事和情报竞争的舞台。
events.connectionHint: It connects to mujahideen support networks, Soviet decline, post-1991 conflicts, and later War on Terror contexts.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到圣战者援助网络、苏联衰落、1991 年后的冲突，以及后来的反恐战争背景。
events.imageAlt: Soviet troops in Afghanistan
events.imageCaption: Soviet-Afghan War imagery shows mechanized power inside a long insurgent conflict.
events.imageCaptionZh: 苏阿战争图像显示机械化力量陷入长期叛乱冲突。

events.title: Berlin Wall falls
events.summary: The opening of the Berlin Wall symbolized the collapse of Cold War division in Europe.
events.summaryZh: 柏林墙开放象征欧洲冷战分裂的崩塌。
sourceNotes: Fall of Berlin Wall is a key symbolic endpoint of Cold War Europe.
events.eventIntro: In November 1989, East German authorities opened border crossings in Berlin after public pressure and political confusion. Crowds crossed, climbed, and dismantled parts of the wall that had divided the city since 1961.
events.eventIntroZh: 1989 年 11 月，在公众压力和政治混乱下，东德当局开放柏林边境通道。人群穿过、攀上并拆除这座自 1961 年以来分裂城市的墙。
events.whyMatters: The fall mattered because it made the Cold War's political geography visibly collapse. It accelerated German reunification and signaled the weakening of Soviet control in Eastern Europe.
events.whyMattersZh: 它重要，因为它让冷战政治地理的崩塌变得可见。它加速德国统一，并显示苏联对东欧控制的削弱。
events.phaseRelation: It closes the Cold War phase by showing that military confrontation could end through civic pressure, regime crisis, and negotiated transformation.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它结束冷战阶段，因为它显示军事对抗也可以通过公民压力、政权危机和协商转型结束。
events.connectionHint: It connects to German reunification, NATO's future, Soviet collapse, and post-Cold War security debates.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到德国统一、北约未来、苏联解体和后冷战安全争论。
events.imageAlt: Crowds at the Berlin Wall near Brandenburg Gate in 1989
events.imageCaption: The wall's opening made the end of Cold War Europe visible in a single urban scene.
events.imageCaptionZh: 柏林墙开放让冷战欧洲的结束在一个城市场景中变得可见。

events.title: Gulf War begins
events.summary: A U.S.-led coalition attacked Iraqi forces after Iraq's invasion of Kuwait, showcasing precision and media-era war.
events.summaryZh: 伊拉克入侵科威特后，美国主导的联军攻击伊拉克军队，展示精确打击和媒介时代战争。
sourceNotes: Gulf War is a standard early post-Cold War conflict and media-war turning point.
events.eventIntro: In 1991, a U.S.-led coalition launched operations to expel Iraqi forces from Kuwait. The war featured air power, precision-guided weapons, satellite media coverage, coalition diplomacy, and oil-security politics.
events.eventIntroZh: 1991 年，美国主导的联军发动行动，将伊拉克军队逐出科威特。战争呈现空中力量、精确制导武器、卫星媒体报道、联盟外交和石油安全政治。
events.whyMatters: It mattered because it seemed to announce a new post-Cold War military order: high-tech coalition war under U.S. leadership. Later conflicts revealed the limits of that model.
events.whyMattersZh: 它重要，因为它似乎宣告了新的后冷战军事秩序：美国领导下的高科技联盟战争。后来的冲突则暴露这种模式的限制。
events.phaseRelation: It opens the post-Cold War phase because precision, media visibility, and coalition legitimacy became central to war presentation.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它开启后冷战阶段，因为精确打击、媒体可见性和联盟合法性成为战争呈现的核心。
events.connectionHint: It connects to U.S. regional basing, sanctions on Iraq, television war, and the 2003 Iraq War.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到美国地区基地、对伊拉克制裁、电视战争和 2003 年伊拉克战争。
events.imageAlt: Coalition tanks during Operation Desert Storm
events.imageCaption: Desert Storm images often framed war as high-speed, mechanized, and technologically precise.
events.imageCaptionZh: 沙漠风暴图像常把战争呈现为高速、机械化和技术精确的行动。

events.title: September 11 attacks
events.summary: Al-Qaeda's attacks on the United States triggered the War on Terror and reshaped global security politics.
events.summaryZh: 基地组织对美国的袭击引发反恐战争，并重塑全球安全政治。
sourceNotes: September 11 attacks are a central event in War on Terror and global security history.
events.eventIntro: On 11 September 2001, al-Qaeda hijackers attacked New York and Washington, D.C., destroying the World Trade Center towers and damaging the Pentagon. The attacks used civilian aviation, media spectacle, and symbolic targets.
events.eventIntroZh: 2001 年 9 月 11 日，基地组织劫机者袭击纽约和华盛顿，摧毁世贸中心双塔并破坏五角大楼。袭击利用民航、媒体奇观和象征性目标。
events.whyMatters: The event mattered because it reorganized security policy, surveillance, military intervention, border controls, and public fear across many countries.
events.whyMattersZh: 它重要，因为它重组了许多国家的安全政策、监控、军事干预、边境管制和公众恐惧。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to post-Cold War asymmetric war because non-state attackers used networks, mobility, media, and symbolic violence against a superpower.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于后冷战非对称战争阶段，因为非国家攻击者利用网络、流动性、媒体和象征性暴力攻击超级大国。
events.connectionHint: It connects to Afghanistan, Iraq, homeland security, Islamophobia, intelligence reform, and drone warfare.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到阿富汗、伊拉克、国土安全、伊斯兰恐惧、情报改革和无人机战争。
events.imageAlt: September 11 attacks photo montage
events.imageCaption: 9/11 images became a defining visual archive of twenty-first-century security politics.
events.imageCaptionZh: 九一一图像成为二十一世纪安全政治的定义性视觉档案。

events.title: Iraq War begins
events.summary: The U.S.-led invasion of Iraq overthrew Saddam Hussein but produced occupation, insurgency, and regional instability.
events.summaryZh: 美国主导入侵伊拉克推翻萨达姆·侯赛因，却带来占领、叛乱和地区不稳定。
sourceNotes: 2003 Iraq invasion is central to post-9/11 military history.
events.eventIntro: In 2003, the United States and allies invaded Iraq, citing weapons of mass destruction and regime change. The invasion rapidly toppled Saddam Hussein but opened a longer period of occupation, insurgency, sectarian conflict, and state reconstruction failure.
events.eventIntroZh: 2003 年，美国及其盟友以大规模杀伤性武器和政权更替为理由入侵伊拉克。入侵迅速推翻萨达姆·侯赛因，却开启更长时期的占领、叛乱、教派冲突和国家重建失败。
events.whyMatters: The war mattered because it exposed the limits of quick regime-change warfare. Intelligence claims, international legitimacy, contractor systems, counterinsurgency, and civilian suffering became central controversies.
events.whyMattersZh: 这场战争重要，因为它暴露快速政权更替战争的限制。情报说法、国际合法性、承包商体系、反叛乱和平民苦难成为核心争议。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to post-Cold War asymmetric war because conventional victory quickly became occupation and insurgency.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于后冷战非对称战争阶段，因为常规胜利迅速转变为占领和叛乱。
events.connectionHint: It connects to War on Terror strategy, ISIS, regional power politics, and debates about intervention.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到反恐战争战略、ISIS、地区权力政治和关于干预的争论。
events.imageAlt: U.S. tank in Baghdad during the Iraq War
events.imageCaption: Baghdad invasion imagery captured the speed of regime collapse and the beginning of occupation.
events.imageCaptionZh: 巴格达入侵图像捕捉了政权崩溃的速度和占领的开始。

events.title: Russia annexes Crimea
events.summary: Russia's seizure and annexation of Crimea challenged post-Cold War borders and security assumptions in Europe.
events.summaryZh: 俄罗斯夺取并吞并克里米亚，挑战后冷战欧洲边界与安全假设。
sourceNotes: Crimea annexation is a central event in post-Cold War European security history.
events.eventIntro: In 2014, Russian forces took control of Crimea after Ukraine's Maidan revolution and a disputed referendum followed. The annexation combined covert military action, local politics, information warfare, and territorial revision.
events.eventIntroZh: 2014 年，在乌克兰广场革命后，俄罗斯力量控制克里米亚，并随后举行有争议的公投。吞并结合了隐蔽军事行动、地方政治、信息战和领土修正。
events.whyMatters: It mattered because it challenged assumptions that European borders were settled after 1991. It also previewed hybrid warfare, sanctions, and renewed NATO-Russia confrontation.
events.whyMattersZh: 它重要，因为它挑战了 1991 年后欧洲边界已经稳定的假设。它也预示混合战争、制裁和北约—俄罗斯对抗重新出现。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to post-Cold War networked war because force, deniability, media narratives, and legal claims operated together.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于后冷战网络化战争阶段，因为武力、否认性、媒体叙事和法律主张共同运作。
events.connectionHint: It connects to Ukraine's later war, energy politics, sanctions, hybrid warfare, and European security debates.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到乌克兰后续战争、能源政治、制裁、混合战争和欧洲安全争论。
events.imageAlt: Crimea referendum scene in 2014
events.imageCaption: Crimea's annexation mixed military presence, political theater, and contested legality.
events.imageCaptionZh: 克里米亚吞并混合了军事存在、政治剧场和有争议的合法性。

events.title: ISIS captures Mosul
events.summary: ISIS seized Mosul and announced a caliphate, turning insurgency, state collapse, and media warfare into a regional crisis.
events.summaryZh: ISIS 占领摩苏尔并宣布建立哈里发国，使叛乱、国家崩溃和媒体战争变成地区危机。
sourceNotes: Mosul's capture is a central event in ISIS and post-Iraq War history.
events.eventIntro: In 2014, ISIS captured Mosul, one of Iraq's largest cities, as Iraqi security forces collapsed. The group used territorial seizure, sectarian violence, online propaganda, foreign fighters, and administrative claims.
events.eventIntroZh: 2014 年，ISIS 在伊拉克安全部队崩溃时占领摩苏尔，这座城市是伊拉克最大城市之一。该组织结合领土夺取、教派暴力、在线宣传、外国战士和行政主张。
events.whyMatters: The event mattered because ISIS briefly transformed jihadist insurgency into territorial rule. It forced regional and international military responses and made digital propaganda part of war.
events.whyMattersZh: 它重要，因为 ISIS 曾短暂把圣战叛乱转化为领土统治。它迫使地区和国际军事回应，并让数字宣传成为战争的一部分。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to asymmetric and networked war because territorial control, ideology, social media, and decentralized recruitment reinforced each other.

events.title: Russia launches full-scale invasion of Ukraine
events.titleZh: 俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰
events.summary: Russia's full-scale invasion turned the war in Ukraine into Europe's largest interstate conflict in decades.
events.summaryZh: 俄罗斯全面入侵使乌克兰战争成为欧洲数十年来最大规模的国家间冲突。
sourceNotes: The 2022 full-scale invasion is a major post-Cold War European war event.
events.eventIntro: In February 2022, Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine after years of conflict since 2014. The war combined conventional offensives, missile strikes, drones, information warfare, sanctions, mobilization, and international military aid.
events.eventIntroZh: 2022 年 2 月，在 2014 年以来长期冲突之后，俄罗斯对乌克兰发动全面入侵。这场战争结合常规进攻、导弹袭击、无人机、信息战、制裁、动员和国际军事援助。
events.whyMatters: The invasion mattered because it overturned assumptions about post-Cold War European security and made industrial capacity, ammunition, energy, drones, and alliances central again.
events.whyMattersZh: 这次入侵重要，因为它推翻了关于后冷战欧洲安全的假设，并重新让工业能力、弹药、能源、无人机和同盟成为核心。
events.phaseRelation: It belongs to post-Cold War networked war because old-style territorial invasion now coexists with satellite intelligence, social media, cyber operations, and drone warfare.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于后冷战网络化战争，因为旧式领土入侵与卫星情报、社交媒体、网络行动和无人机战争并存。
events.connectionHint: It connects to NATO enlargement, energy politics, sanctions, drone warfare, artillery production, and global food security.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到北约扩大、能源政治、制裁、无人机战争、炮弹生产和全球粮食安全。
events.imageAlt: Map of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine
events.imageCaption: Maps of the invasion show how territorial war returned alongside networked intelligence and global sanctions.
events.imageCaptionZh: 入侵地图显示领土战争如何与网络化情报和全球制裁一同回归。
